status: Single-run Aperture replay has lower private RAM and calibrated CPU than saved VLC; broad stable performance ranking remains unproven.
method: One explicitly authorized visible Aperture launch; no VLC launch and no discarded warmup. Same SHA256-verified 180s 1080p30 H264/AAC stereo fixture, fresh owned portable profile, actual 1280x720 video canvas at 96 DPI. Seven raw process/cycle/memory snapshots span 30.0146089 seconds after >=10s media time and settling; media advances from 10.0667 to 40.0667s. No other builds, profilers or tests ran during timing. CPU = cycle delta / actual elapsed / independently validated same-CPU invariant-TSC rate *100, percent of one logical processor; whole-machine capacity divides by 24. Raw sampled CPU time is retained separately. Private RAM and working set are median snapshots; GPU value is dedicated allocation, not GPU time. The saved VLC reference retains its original 2026-10-18T18:57:51.4393218Z batch date/session and original calibration; it requests D3D11/D3D11VA/linear scaling. Aperture retains balanced Lanczos-up/Hermite-down/correct-downscaling, bilinear chroma, no linear-light/sigmoid passes, with guarded direct NV12 optimization. Filters differ between players. Memory categories overlap and are not summed.

versusPreviousAperture.note: Separate historical sessions; not a controlled attribution of the entire difference to one code change.

limits: One measured Aperture launch. Snapshot ranges are not repeat-run variability; no stable overall ranking or all-format win follows.
Saved baselines are reused with their original dates, protocols, sessions and raw counters. No same-session reference link is fabricated.

Sampled process CPU-time accounting reports Aperture 4.9455 versus VLC 4.5295 percent of one processor; that counter does not show a CPU win. The small calibrated-cycle lead is counter- and session-dependent.
Advancing media and canvas were verified. This visible trial did not capture presented frames, dropped-frame counts, actual decoder/filter path or audio sink activity.
Previously recorded 14 paired frame cases and 79 hidden native checks remain separate validation, not fresh visible frame-quality/cadence verification.
Process-to-visible-window measures a shell, not time to visible video. Supplied runtime sizes are not feature-matched distributions.
Candidate is a prebuilt dirty-worktree portable runtime. No installation, release or restart was performed.

preflight.initialFailure: Optional VLC path was still resolved unconditionally; failure occurred before output creation or player launch.
preflight.fix: Resolve VLC runtime only when VLC is selected.
preflight.validation: PowerShell parse and selected/unselected VLC initialization branch checks passed without launching a player.
